agency_name: NC Department of Natural and Cultural Resources
mission: We enrich people's lives through education and stewardship of North Carolina's natural and cultural resources.

goals.title: Education through DNCR resources
goals.description: Promote education using DNCR resources by pairing with local schools to promote lesson plans, class visits, extracurricular activities, and field trips to DNCR sites.

goals.title: Community and tourism
goals.description: Utilize DNCR sites to uplift local communities by adding amenities and partnering with local communities to host events that will increase tourism and visibility.

goals.title: Protect, restore, and expand access to resources
goals.description: Protect, restore, and enhance natural and cultural resources by expanding appropriate programs. Also make sites and green spaces more accessible to underserved communities, veterans, retirees, etc both in person and digitally.

goals.title: Efficiency and public engagement
goals.description: Improve the agency's efficiency and customer service. Improve internal cohesion through greater collaboration and clearer common objectives. Meanwhile, use cohesion to reinforce re-branding and expand opportunities for public engagement and feedback.

goals.title: Hurricane Helene recovery and resilience
goals.description: Repair damage done to DNCR sites by Hurricane Helene while using funding to also support affected communities. Enact measures to future proof the sites and vulnerable areas from future natural disasters and potential consequences of climate change.
